_comment: Copy to time_sync.json (gitignored — it holds admin passwords).
tolerance_seconds: how far a clock may drift before it counts as wrong.
The node's `clock` reply only has minute resolution, so a correctly-set
node can read up to 59s behind. Keep this above 60.
reply_timeout: seconds to wait for an admin CLI reply over the mesh.
Each node needs the advertised name (or a pubkey prefix) and the admin
password. set_time=true lets the script push the correct time; with
Note: firmware refuses to move a clock backwards, so a node running
AHEAD cannot be fixed over the mesh and needs a power cycle.
